name: AMR Volume Ray-Casting
definition: A volume rendering technique that ray-marches Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR) octrees directly without resampling to a uniform grid, avoiding the $(2^{l_{max}})^3$ memory blow-up. Each ray steps by the local cell size, so computational cost scales with the simulation data rather than the bounding box.
summary: AMR Volume Ray-Casting renders sparse data by ray-marching AMR octrees directly, avoiding uniform grid resampling to prevent memory blow-up and maintain native resolution.
